title: 3D Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Analista FP&A júnior

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.

title: Director of Procurement
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

1. Fully responsible for the company's procurement in the Latin American region, and for developing and optimizing regional procurement strategies.

2. Lead market research in Latin America, analyze regional industry trends, supplier capabilities, and market risks to support the company's procurement strategy and project decision-making.

3. Manage and deeply maintain the regional supplier ecosystem, regularly evaluate the quality of suppliers' products and services, and drive improvements in key supply chain systems.

4. Guide and participate in the negotiation, review, and management of procurement contracts to ensure they are legal and compliant, protecting the company's interests.

5. Develop and implement procurement cost control plans, continuously drive improvements in procurement processes, efficiency, and cost optimization to enhance project profitability.

6. Build and improve regional procurement processes, policies, and systems, promoting standardized procurement and digital advancement to achieve compliant and transparent processes.

7. Collaborate with delivery, operations, and other relevant departments, as well as headquarters resources, to effectively support the smooth execution of regional projects.


Job Requirements

  • 1. Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in a science or engineering major.
  • 2. Over 10 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management, with required experience in procurement in Latin America.
  • 3. Thorough understanding of procurement processes and cross-cultural supplier management, capable of independently leading procurement negotiations and maintaining supplier relationships.
  • 4. Strong cost awareness and data analysis abilities, with proven success in procurement cost control.
  • 5. Strong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills, able to efficiently handle regional procurement emergencies.
  • 6. Highly responsible, self-motivated, big-picture thinker, able to handle pressure at key delivery milestones.
  • 7. Proficient in English, able to frequently travel across Latin American countries.
  • 8. Experience in building and managing procurement systems in the Latin American region for Fortune 500, international energy, or engineering companies is preferred.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is seeking an independent Internal Auditor to establish and execute our internal audit framework required for Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) VASP/PSAV authorization under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025.

In this role, you will objectively evaluate the effectiveness of our governance, risk management processes, AML/CFT controls (Circular BCB No. 3,978/2020), cybersecurity measures, and cross-border payment operations.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Plan & Execution: Design and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan approved by the Board of Directors.
  • AML/CFT & Regulatory Testing: Conduct independent testing of AML/CFT controls (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, SAR/ROS procedures).
  • Custody & Segregation Review: Evaluate asset segregation and digital asset custody controls in compliance with BCB regulations (e.g., Res. BCB 520).
  • Cybersecurity & Tech Audits: Assess IT controls, key management, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Business Continuity (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP) frameworks (Res. BCB 552 / Res. BCB 85).
  • Reporting & Escalation: Report findings, control deficiencies, and remediation status directly to the Board. Support mock regulatory audits and pre-filing BCB readiness reviews.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven experience in internal/external audit or risk assurance within financial institutions, payment institutions (IP), or licensed VASPs/crypto entities in Brazil.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the BCB regulatory framework (Res. BCB 552, Circ. 3,978/2020).
  • Certifications: CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, CPA, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Portuguese.

Desired Competencies

  • Financial Controls & Governance: Strong expertise in evaluating internal control frameworks, corporate governance, operational workflows, and segregation of customer assets.
  • Regulatory Reporting & Audit Expertise: Familiarity with BCB audit requirements and regulatory systems, including Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), COSIF accounting frameworks, and AML/CFT compliance.
  • Executive Presence & Independence: Ability to report directly and present objective findings to the Board of Directors and external regulators without operational bias.
  • Strong Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Demonstrated skill in conducting root-cause analyses, dissecting complex transaction logs, and identifying systemic control gaps.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Results-driven approach to tracking audit remediation plans and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate constructively with Compliance, Risk, Engineering, and Finance teams while maintaining strict audit independence.
  • Ability to build scalable audit infrastructure: Experience establishing risk-based internal audit methodologies, automated sampling procedures, and testing frameworks that scale from early-stage authorization to high-volume cross-border operations.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-Border & FX Audit Experience: Background auditing foreign exchange (Câmbio/eFX), international remittance rails, and multi-currency liquidity settlement.
  • Digital Assets & Crypto Auditing: Practical knowledge auditing blockchain transactions, digital asset custody (Res. BCB 520), and stablecoin flows (USDT/USDC).
  • Professional Certifications: Active CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CFA, or active CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • RegTech & Automation Tools: Experience testing or auditing automated transaction monitoring, automated BACEN reporting software, and reconciliation engines.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location : Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)


Reporting to : Latin America Regional Lead


1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.


  • As Latin America’s largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.


  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.


2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials’ supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil’s industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.


3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor’s degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;


  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;


  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst

The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are accurately captured, documented, and translated into functional requirements that support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and effectively transfer knowledge to development teams.
  • Evaluate information collected through task analysis, business process reviews, surveys, interviews, and workshops.
  • Understand, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements.

title: Survey & Insights Analyst
description:
Your Responsibilities:

The Survey & Insights Analyst supports Lockton's enterprise survey consultancy function, partnering with business units and geographies worldwide to design, deploy, and analyze surveys that create actionable insights. This role serves as a hands-on Qualtrics practitioner and analytical partner, helping internal teams translate research questions into survey programs and actionable findings while upholding data governance and privacy standards across regions.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, build, and program surveys in Qualtrics, including logic/branching, bilingual and multi-language routing, embedded data, and distribution workflows.

  • Partner with stakeholders across regions and business units to scope survey requests, define objectives, and translate business questions into effective instrument design.
  • Clean, analyze, and synthesize survey data into reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and Associates.
  • Support data governance efforts, including PII/PHI risk review, survey inventory management, and adherence to global privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Provide consulting, training, and technical support to survey requestors throughout the survey lifecycle, from intake through post-deployment analysis.
  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical, audiences.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT PMO, Digital Office, and People Solutions teams as needed


Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 1+ years of experience in survey research, data analysis, market research, or a related analytical field
  • Demonstrated experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics (or a comparable enterprise survey platform) required
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data from multiple sources and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality or accuracy
  • Comfortable working across time zones with globally distributed teams; some flexibility in working hours may be required

title: Analista Fiscal Diretos
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de produtos avançados para cuidados com a visão, óculos e soluções de Med-Tech.


Nossa missão é Empowering Humans : empoderamos as pessoas por meio de tecnologias de lentes inovadoras, como Varilux, Stellest e Transitions; marcas icônicas como Ray-Ban, Oakley e Vogue Eyewear; as mais desejadas marcas licenciadas de luxo e bandeiras de varejo de classe mundial, como Sunglass Hut, GrandVision, Solaris e Óticas Carol.


A EssilorLuxottica está moldando um futuro no qual nossos olhos se tornam um poderoso portal de acesso capaz de elevar o potencial humano, revelar informações sobre a saúde e nos conectar com o mundo de maneiras completamente novas. Há gerações redefinimos os limites da visão, criando produtos de excelência, belos e de alto desempenho, que melhoram a visão valorizando a expressão pessoal.


Com mais de 200.000 colaboradores em 150 países, seguiremos elevando a forma como as pessoas veem o mundo, aproveitando nossos pontos fortes que vão da inovação med-tech ao diagnóstico, passando pelos wearables, IA e biometria, dando um significado mais profundo à saúde, ao bem-estar e às conexões.


Estamos em busca de um novo colaborador(a) para fazer parte da nossa equipe como Analista Fiscal de Diretos Pleno


Nessa posição, você irá analisar, apurar e controlar os tributos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL) das empresas do grupo, assegurando a conformidade fiscal, a correta contabilização dos tributos e o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias. Atuar nos processos de fechamento e reporte tributário de múltiplas empresas, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos fiscais, atendimento às exigências corporativas e melhoria contínua dos processos da área.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Apuração e fechamento de IRPJ e CSLL:

Realizar a apuração mensal e anual de IRPJ e CSLL das empresas sob sua responsabilidade.

Efetuar o controle de adições, exclusões, compensações, prejuízos fiscais e bases negativas.

Analisar provisões tributárias, tributos correntes e diferidos.

Suportar os fechamentos mensais, trimestrais e anuais.


Conciliação contábil:

Realizar conciliações contábeis das contas de tributos diretos.

Controlar saldos de impostos diferidos, prejuízos fiscais e bases negativas.

Analisar variações entre resultado contábil e fiscal.

Garantir a consistência das informações tributárias reportadas.


Obrigações acessórias (ECF, MIT, DIRBI)

Elaborar, revisar e validar informações para ECF, MIT e demais obrigações aplicáveis.

Suportar retificações e regularizações quando necessárias.

Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e requisitos legais.


Reportes corporativos e atendimento a demandas internas:

Preparar informações tributárias para reportes locais e corporativos.

Atender demandas de Corporate, Contabilidade, Controladoria e auditorias.

Elaborar análises e suportes técnicos relacionados aos tributos diretos.


Apoio a auditorias fiscais e controles internos:

Organizar documentação suporte e evidências.

Apoiar fiscalizações e revisões tributárias quando demandado.


Acompanhamento de legislação e melhoria de processos:

Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e automação da área.

Propor melhorias em controles, procedimentos e fluxos de trabalho.

Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária aplicável.


Requisitos Minimos:

Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência em empresas tributadas pelo Lucro Real;

Vivência em fechamentos contábeis e fiscais;

Experiência em apuração de IRPJ e CSLL e análise de demonstrações financeiras


Habilidades:

'Conhecimento e experiência contábil aplicado à tributação;

Experiência em apuração de IRPJ e CSLL;

Excel avançado (PROCX, SOMASES e Tabelas Dinâmicas) – obrigatório;

Conhecimento em automação de processos e ferramentas de IA – desejável;

Conhecimento em SAP e/ou Oracle – desejável;

Perfil analítico, senso crítico e atenção aos detalhes.


No Brasil, temos um programa de Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão estruturado para ampliar oportunidades para todos.


Faça parte da nossa empresa e contribua para Empowering Humans . Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Supervisor de Vendas - Tietê Plaza Shopping
description:

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.


Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!


Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:


  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.
  • Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.


Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:


  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação


Informações adicionais:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.


Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!


O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.


Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

  1. 制定并实施拉美区域人力资源战略规划，定期撰写人力资源状况分析报告。

  10. 完成领导临时交办的工作。

任职要求

  • 教育背景 ：本科及以上学历，人力资源或相关管理类专业。
  • 工作经验 ：3年及以上拉美区域人力资源管理工作经验。
  • 知识要求 ：了解基本企业管理知识，熟悉人力资源管理知识，熟悉拉美地区人力资源市场动态及相关劳动政策法规。
  • 基本技能 ：具备一定的写作能力、谈判能力，能够熟练操作计算机办公软件。
  • 核心能力 ：具有较强的计划、组织、协调、分析、沟通、人际交往、语言和文字表达能力。具备出色的跨文化沟通能力及团队协作精神。
  • 特殊要求 ：英语可作为工作语言，有拉美地区人力资源从业经验。
  • 优先条件 ：具备中文语言能力者优先考虑。

title: Garena Internship 2027
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

Are you ready to be a part of the world’s most popular mobile game company? We are looking for driven students to join our Internship Program 2027, where you will have the opportunity to choose your focus track: Operations or Marketing.


You will be an integral part of our core squad, mastering the product from the inside out and taking ownership of the engines that keep the game alive and thriving. This role is designed to fast-track you, tailored to your chosen path:


Operations Track: You will focus on product execution and live systems. Your responsibilities include managing the in-game economy, planning and executing major regional live events, and using data analysis to optimize player retention and ensure seamless daily game operations.


Marketing Track: You will focus on growth, branding, and player acquisition. Your responsibilities include planning and executing high-impact marketing campaigns, analyzing user acquisition (UA) performance data to maximize campaign ROI, and managing local influencer networks and community strategies to expand and engage our player base.


Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Requirements

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Analytical Excellence: Ability to use data to justify operational decisions and optimize the player experience.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 30 hours per week (6h/day) starting January 2027 in São Paulo/SP.


Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

title: Analista de Ponto Eletrônico Sênior | Administração de Pessoal
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.


No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 162 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.


A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.


Descrição do Cargo

Responsável pela gestão dos processos de controle de jornada (Ponto eletrônico), garantindo conformidade legal, precisão dos registros e integração com a folha de pagamento. Atua como especialista do sistema WebCenter , suportando a gestão de escalas, monitoramento de indicadores e desenvolvimento de soluções para otimização operacional. Presta consultoria aos gestores em temas relacionados à legislação trabalhista e gestão da força de trabalho, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e o fortalecimento do compliance. Também lidera iniciativas de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e implantação de sistemas na área de Administração de Pessoal.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de ponta a ponta os processos de controle de jornada e frequência, assegurando o correto registro das horas trabalhadas, o fechamento mensal do ponto e a integração com a folha de pagamento.
  • Administrar o sistema WebCenter (próprio da AutoZone), atuando na implementação, configuração, manutenção, gestão de escalas e monitoramento de desvios de jornada, garantindo aderência às necessidades operacionais e de negócio.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para gestores em temas relacionados à jornada de trabalho, escalas de turnos, banco de horas e legislação trabalhista, fornecendo orientação, treinamento e suporte técnico.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à efetividade operacional, absenteísmo, horas extras, aderência às escalas e produtividade da força de trabalho.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e otimização operacional, propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para a área de Administração de Pessoal.
  • Realizar análises de riscos trabalhistas relacionados à jornada de trabalho, apoiando ações preventivas e corretivas para garantir conformidade legal e reduzir passivos.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, normas corporativas e requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis.
  • Participar e liderar iniciativas de implantação de sistemas, transformação digital e projetos de compliance trabalhista.
  • Desenvolver estudos, relatórios gerenciais e análises estratégicas para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Promover a padronização, documentação e melhoria contínua dos processos de Administração de Pessoal.


Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em administração de ponto eletrônico com operações de grande porte, preferencialmente com mais de 1.000 colaboradores.
  • Vivência na análise de dados e no desenvolvimento de indicadores, utilizando Excel Avançado, Power BI e/ou Looker Studio
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista.
  • Experiência em integrações sistêmicas, validação de dados e parametrização de sistemas.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Diferencial experiência com o sistema ADP.


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Que tal fazer parte dessa jornada?

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Objetivo da posição

  • Garantir o cumprimento das políticas, procedimentos e prazos estabelecidos pela empresa.


Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área financeira, preferencialmente com atuação em Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber ou Tesouraria.
  • Conhecimento em fluxo de caixa e conciliação financeira.
  • Conhecimento em Excel.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade analítica para conferência e interpretação de informações financeiras.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de franquias, varejo ou operações multisites.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Conhecimento em processos de faturamento e cobrança.
  • Vivência com indicadores e relatórios financeiros.
  • Experiência com melhoria e automatização de processos.
  • Conhecimento em orçamento e Forecast.
  • Experiência em empresas em crescimento acelerado.


Competências

  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Atenção aos detalhes.
  • Senso de prioridade.
  • Proatividade.
  • Comunicação clara.
  • Trabalho em equipe.
  • Responsabilidade e comprometimento.
  • Foco em resultados.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua.


O que esperamos

Buscamos um profissional organizado, analítico e com perfil mão na massa, que tenha atenção aos detalhes e facilidade para trabalhar com números e informações financeiras. Esperamos alguém que tenha senso de responsabilidade sobre suas entregas, consiga lidar com diferentes demandas e prazos e tenha interesse em aprender e contribuir para a evolução dos processos da área.


Mais do que executar rotinas, buscamos alguém que consiga identificar inconsistências, propor melhorias e contribuir para que o financeiro seja cada vez mais organizado, eficiente e estratégico para o negócio.

title: [Financeiro] Analista de FP&A Sênior - Cloud

title: Head of Business Development Americas
description:
About the opportunity


A multinational energy group is seeking a senior executive to lead its Business Development strategy and support the continued growth of its operations in Americas.


This is a highly visible leadership position for an executive with extensive experience in the Americas power sector, strong commercial and institutional relationships, and a proven ability to originate, structure and develop complex energy and infrastructure projects.


The executive will play a central role in defining the company’s growth strategy, identifying new opportunities and building long-term relationships with clients, partners, investors, financial institutions, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.


The position involves close interaction with the company’s global executive leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the entire project value chain.


Key responsibilities


  • Define and execute the Business Development strategy for Americas, aligned with the company’s global objectives.
  • Originate and evaluate new renewable energy and infrastructure opportunities, including greenfield developments, partnerships and potential acquisitions.
  • Identify prospective clients and offtakers and support the origination and negotiation of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).
  • Monitor power market, regulatory environment, economic trends and evolving customer needs.
  • Develop and maintain senior-level relationships with authorities, regulatory agencies, industry associations, clients, partners, investors, lenders and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Lead project development activities, including opportunity assessment, commercial structuring, bid preparation, negotiations and investment decision processes.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams.
  • Assess commercial, regulatory, technical and financial risks and ensure they are appropriately reflected in business cases and financial models.
  • Support project acquisitions, strategic partnerships, tender processes and other growth initiatives.
  • Represent the company in relevant business forums, institutional meetings and industry events.
  • Provide leadership, direction and development to the team, promoting collaboration and effective execution.


Qualifications and experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Law or another relevant field.
  • At least 15 years of professional experience, including significant experience in executive or senior leadership positions.
  • Strong track record in Business Development within the energy or infrastructure sectors.
  • Experience working in multinational companies and complex matrix organizations.
  • English and Spanish are required.
  • Availability for business travel.


Leadership profile


We are looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially minded executive who combines strategic perspective with the ability to deliver results.


  • Strong business judgment and ability to identify value-creating opportunities.
  • Executive presence and credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex commercial and institutional environments.
  • Collaborative leadership across functions, cultures and geographies.
  • Strong governance, integrity and risk-management orientation.
  • Ability to build teams, develop talent and lead through change.
  • Independence, adaptability and a hands-on approach when required.


Why join?


The successful candidate will operate with broad exposure to global leadership and will have the opportunity to shape the company’s long-term positioning and expansion in America´s market.

This recruitment process is being conducted on a confidential basis. Additional information about the company and the position will be shared with selected candidates during the process.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and diverse selection process.

description:

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


Responsabilidades da posição:

  • Realizar atendimento consultivo aos clientes, identificando suas necessidades visuais e recomendando as lentes de contato mais adequadas;
  • Orientar e conduzir o processo de adaptação de novos usuários de lentes de contato, garantindo segurança, conforto e confiança durante a transição dos óculos para as lentes;
  • Demonstrar as características, benefícios e diferenciais dos produtos, oferecendo recomendações personalizadas de acordo com o estilo de vida e perfil de cada cliente;
  • Efetuar provas, adaptações e acompanhamento pós-venda, assegurando a correta utilização e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Contribuir para o atingimento das metas de vendas por meio de um atendimento de excelência, fidelização e relacionamento contínuo com os clientes;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre lançamentos, tecnologias e inovações relacionadas às lentes de contato e saúde visual;
  • Apoiar a organização da loja, controle de estoque de lentes de contato e materiais relacionados, garantindo a disponibilidade dos produtos;
  • Atuar em parceria com a equipe da loja para proporcionar uma experiência de compra diferenciada e alinhada aos padrões de excelência.

Requisitos da posição:

  • Ensino técnico óptico ou graduação em óptica e optometria (obrigatório)
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e atendimento ao cliente;
  • Conhecimento sobre lentes de contato, soluções e cuidados com a saúde ocular;
  • Disponibilidade de horário para atuação no varejo;
  • Conhecimento no segmento óptico será considerado um diferencial.

title: Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)
description:
Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)

Reports To: Head Of Media Sales & Service, LATAM

Location: Brazil, Remote (São Paulo)


About us

Broadsign is a leading programmatic ad tech company on a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our platform powers the world’s most successful OOH and retail media businesses while enabling agencies and brands to seamlessly plan and execute dynamic OOH campaigns across the globe. Come light up the world as a Sales Director.


Position Summary

Your day-to-day will vary but your mission is simple; as a key member of our Programmatic Team, you will be taking full responsibility for business development activities by educating buyers on the new opportunities brought forth by our products. Your patch will consist of media buyers from agencies, brands and DSP partners. You’ll put your sales experience to use by determining client needs and recommending optimal programmatic DOOH proposals and supporting agency-wide agreements.


Of course, if this role speaks to you, you’re someone who has;

  • 5-10 years sales experience in the media world; you understand agencies and what advertisers care about
  • Proven understanding of the digital programmatic world and/or the programmatic digital out-of-home ecosystem
  • Interest in engaging with new buyers by introducing them to the benefits of programmatic DOOH and the innovative advertising opportunities via the Broadsign programmatic stack
  • Excellent presentation skills - you know how to craft a pitch
  • Strong organisational skills
  • You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and perform well under pressure
  • Great communication and collaborative approach with teammates
  • This is a primarily remote role; however, we believe face-to-face connection drives the best results. You will be expected to make a best-effort approach to conducting in-person client meetings. To support your success, you will have full access to WeWork spaces.
  • Travel will primarily be within Brazil for client meetings, with occasional travel throughout LATAM for industry and company events.
  • This role requires professional fluency in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is highly advantageous.


What we bring to the table

  • Health & Dental Insurance: Supplemental private medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents. You’ll also have access to unlimited online mental health support through BetterHelp for you and your family.
  • Wellness & Remote Fund: R$ 3,000 annual flexible budget for home office, wellness, or internet expenses
  • Paid Time Off: Statutory 30 calendar days of paid rest after 12 months, plus the mandatory 1/3 vacation bonus, 5 "floater" days, 2 paid volunteer days, and 3 paid training days per year!
  • Daycare Assistance: Monthly financial support/reimbursement for early-childhood daycare (Auxílio-Creche )
  • Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth.


At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Gestão e Desempenho Pleno para fazer parte do nosso time em São Paulo-SP !

  • Apoiar a definição, cálculo e negociação de metas junto às áreas, assegurando que sejam desafiadoras, mensuráveis e alinhadas aos objetivos corporativos.
  • Monitorar e analisar o desempenho dos indicadores, identificando desvios, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria para garantir o alcance dos resultados estabelecidos.

  • Desenvolver e aprimorar dashboards e análises em Power BI, automatizando o acompanhamento dos indicadores e disponibilizando informações confiáveis para a tomada de decisão.
  • Utilizar automação de dados e soluções de Inteligência Artificial para aumentar a eficiência dos processos de gestão, análise e acompanhamento da performance corporativa.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisito Obrigatório:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia;
  • Conhecimento de Power BI – criação de dashboards, indicadores, modelagem e análise de dados;

  • Certificação em Lean Six Sigma (Yellow/Green Belt);

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

O(a) profissional atuará diretamente em atividades de fechamento contábil, conciliações, elaboração de demonstrações financeiras, consolidação societária, análise de CPC e IFRS, equivalência patrimonial e atendimento às auditorias interna e externa.


A posição também terá participação relevante na elaboração de reports gerenciais e apresentações dos resultados mensais, contribuindo para a geração de informações confiáveis para a Diretoria e o Corporativo.


Sobre a área


A área de Contabilidade é responsável por assegurar a integridade das informações contábeis e financeiras da companhia, garantindo aderência às normas vigentes, qualidade dos fechamentos e suporte à tomada de decisão.


A área atua de forma integrada com Controladoria, Fiscal, Tesouraria e demais áreas do negócio, além de possuir interface com auditorias internas e externas.

Fechamento e rotinas contábeis:

  • Realizar a contabilização da folha de pagamento;
  • Realizar apropriações de despesas antecipadas;
  • Analisar o cadastro e a contabilização de bens do ativo imobilizado;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das práticas e normas contábeis, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e o compliance da companhia.


Demonstrações Financeiras e Consolidação:


  • Apoiar a elaboração das demonstrações financeiras;
  • Executar processos de consolidação societária;
  • Realizar cálculos e análises de equivalência patrimonial;
  • Analisar impactos e aplicações das normas contábeis CPC e IFRS;
  • Garantir consistência e qualidade das informações utilizadas nos processos de fechamento e consolidação.


Reporting e análises:


  • Elaborar reports contábeis e gerenciais;
  • Preparar apresentações dos resultados mensais;
  • Analisar informações contábeis para identificação de variações, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Apoiar a preparação de informações para a Diretoria e o Corporativo.


Auditoria, Compliance e Processos:


  • Atender auditorias internas e externas;
  • Preparar informações e documentações necessárias aos processos de auditoria;
  • Apoiar a implementação de novos sistemas e melhorias nos processos contábeis;
  • Acompanhar alterações de legislação, normas e procedimentos internos com impacto contábil;
  • Contribuir para a qualidade, padronização e melhoria contínua das rotinas da área.


Formação Acadêmica


  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis;
  • CRC será considerado importante para a posição.


Experiência Profissional


  • Experiência sólida na área de Contabilidade;

  • Experiência com elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência com conciliações e análises de contas contábeis;
  • Vivência com reporting contábil e gerencial;
  • Experiência com auditorias internas e/ou externas;
  • Vivência com consolidação societária será considerada relevante para a posição.


Conhecimentos Técnicos

title: Médico (a) Psiquiatra - UBS Regiões do Campo Limpo e Vila Andrade
description:
Sobre nós

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


Informações sobre a vaga

  • Jornada de Trabalho : 100hr/mês
  • Unidade de Trabalho : Unidades Básicas de Saúde nas regiões do Campo Limpo, Paraisópolis e Vila Andrade, geridas pela parceria SBIBAE-SMS-SP


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atividades de tutoria e/ou acompanhamento de estágios em serviço (residência, graduação ou cursos técnicos);
  • Prestar atendimento médico ambulatorial, bem como realizar procedimentos, terapias e exames de diagnóstico, atuando nas áreas assistenciais, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas pela Instituição, Secretaria Municipal de Saúde e Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada nos processos de promoção, prevenção e recuperação da saúde fortalecendo o trabalho em equipe, no atendimento aos pacientes que busquem no serviço através de demanda espontânea e referenciada;
  • Realizar avaliação, manejo, e seguimento de pacientes com transtornos mentais, realizando cuidado conjunto com a equipe da ESF, na perspectiva da corresponsabilidade;
  • Qualificar o encaminhamento para a atenção especializada, quando necessário;
  • Trabalhar em equipe multiprofissional, colaborando na construção coletiva do projeto institucional da unidade e nos Projetos terapêuticos singulares dos usuários, participando das reuniões de equipe;
  • Promover o vínculo terapêutico, escuta atenta e compreensão empática nas ações aos usuários e familiares;
  • Atuar de forma humanizada na relação com o usuário e familiar, conforme Filosofia Planetree e diretrizes de qualidade e segurança do paciente;
  • Efetuar registro escrito, individualizado e sistemático, no prontuário, contendo os dados relevantes da permanência do usuário.


Requisito imprescindíveis

  • Graduação concluída em Medicina;
  • Residência Médica concluída em Psiquiatria.


Etapas do processo seletivo

Conforme política de contratação médica, o processo contempla as seguintes etapas:

  • Análise de currículo;
  • Avaliação Técnica (Prova);
  • Entrevista com comitê formado especificamente para o processo.

Todas as etapas do processo seletivo são de caráter eliminatório.


Einstein Benefícios – Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Programa Cuidar com serviços realizados no Einstein para promover a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores e dependentes, Clínicas Einstein, Telemedicina, Convênio Farmácia, Convênio Médico, Assistência Odontológica e Consultório Dental in Company.
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (Gympass), TotalPass, Coral, Programa de Orientação Pessoal e SESC.
  • Para você e sua família: Licença paternidade estendida, Seguro de Vida, Creche ou Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal, Auxílio para Filhos com Deficiência e Previdência Privada com taxa zero.
  • Alimentação: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição ou Refeitório no local de trabalho.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Fretado, Estacionamento, Aplicativo de Caronas e Circular Metrô.
  • Clube de Benefícios: Para economizar e obter vantagens nas compras de produtos e serviços de diversas categorias, como Beleza e Fitness, Comer e Beber, Compras, Cultura e Lazer, Educação Ensino Einstein, Turismo e muito mais.
  • Programa Mais Conectados: Trabalho remoto nas modalidades Teletrabalho ou Híbrido conforme atividade e área de atuação.


**Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a convenção coletiva, unidade de trabalho e políticas vigentes.


IMPORTANTE: Para sua segurança, esclarecemos que o Einstein não cobra valores para participação em processos seletivos e não exige a realização de cursos ou pagamentos de qualquer natureza como condição para candidatura às nossas oportunidades. Em caso de dúvidas, consulte nossos canais oficiais.

title: [Produto] Especialista em UX Product Design
description:
Descrição da vaga

Como UX Product Designer Especialista, você será o guardião das premissas e boas práticas de usabilidade, user interface e Design Thinking na plataforma de dados e IA da TOTVS, garantindo a consistência visual e a qualidade da experiência dos nossos produtos.


Você atuará conduzindo pesquisa, prototipação e validação de soluções de ponta a ponta, evoluindo o Design System e as ferramentas que apoiam o trabalho dos designers, e terá papel ativo na disseminação da cultura de UX na organização, orientando designers menos experientes e sustentando um padrão alto de trabalho entre as squads.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários para identificar necessidades, comportamentos e problemas de usabilidade.
  • Formular hipóteses, realizar testes e validar soluções ao longo do processo de design.
  • Liderar a criação de wireframes, user flows, jornadas e protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade.
  • Atuar na evolução e disseminação do Design System, incluindo novos componentes, fluxos e templates.
  • Gerenciar libraries, assets e handoff de componentes para desenvolvimento.
  • Avaliar e garantir boas práticas de usabilidade e acessibilidade nos produtos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Designers, Desenvolvedores, Agilistas, POs, PMs e Tribes na construção de soluções.
  • Facilitar workshops, entrevistas, dinâmicas de ideação e priorização, aplicando Design Thinking e Design Sprint.
  • Estruturar propostas e cronogramas de UX, alinhando pesquisa e prototipação ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Promover a cultura de UX e disseminar boas práticas dentro da organização.
  • Orientar profissionais menos experientes e contribuir para a evolução da qualidade de UX nas squads.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em UX/Product Design, com atuação em pesquisa, prototipação e Design Systems.
  • Experiência na operação e evolução de Design Systems, incluindo gestão de libraries, assets e handoff.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de informação, wireframes, interação, layout, protótipos navegáveis e testes de usabilidade.
  • Experiência com pesquisa, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e validação de conceitos.
  • Conhecimento de heurísticas de Nielsen, usabilidade e acessibilidade aplicadas a produtos digitais.
  • Conhecimento de Design Thinking e Design Sprint, com experiência em projetos de alta complexidade.
  • Experiência com facilitação de workshops, entrevistas, validações e testes.
  • Conhecimento em Figma e Axure, ou outras ferramentas de prototipação de média e alta fidelidade.
  • Experiência no planejamento de projetos e cronogramas de UX.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e squads multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação, referências e interação com ferramentas e comunidades.
  • Ensino superior completo em Design, Publicidade, Comunicação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações ou cursos em UX, como CPUX, UXPA, Interaction Design Foundation (IDF), CID ou NN/g UX Certification.
  • Experiência na evolução e disseminação de Design Systems em ambientes com múltiplos produtos e squads.
  • Experiência com produtos digitais corporativos e jornadas de adoção e onboarding de clientes.
  • Experiência com produtos de dados, Analytics ou IA, traduzindo conceitos técnicos em interfaces claras e acionáveis.
  • Conhecimento de Future Thinking e sua aplicação estratégica.
  • Experiência com Research Ops e documentação e compartilhamento sistemático de pesquisas.
